headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2020, a new chapter began as Kenny Omega vs. Sammy Guevara fought for the brand-new AAA Mega Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.54 ? a strong outing. The first-ever AAA Mega Championship match to air on Dynamite, taped during the strange early days of the pandemic ? Guevara wrestled to a custom fan section of cardboard cutouts he'd made himself, adding surreal comedy to an otherwise hard-fought title defense.
Flash back to 2026, when Darby Allin vs. Rush fought it out in a No Count Out Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.63 ? a strong outing.

2022 brought us this moment: Ricky Starks vs. Swerve Strickland went to battle over the FTW Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. It was the first title opportunity of Swerve Strickland's career. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2026, when Kenny Omega vs. Swerve Strickland fought it out with the Authority Position and a Number One Contender spot on the line, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 8.18 ? one of the better matches of the year.
Turning the clock back to 2026: AEW welcomed The Dogs (Connors & Finlay) for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.80.
Flash back to 2020, when Jimmy Havoc returned to the fold after 4 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
